description: This file defines interfaces, macros, and data structures for ACPI (Advanced Configuration and Power Interface) support within the Zephyr project, including resource management, device info retrieval, and ACPI table parsing.

methods.name: acpi_irq_res_get
methods.description: Parses resource table for irq info and returns IRQ resource list.

methods.name: acpi_device_irq_get
methods.description: Parses resource table for IRQ info for a device.

methods.name: acpi_device_mmio_get
methods.description: Parses resource table for MMIO info for a device.

methods.name: acpi_device_type_get
methods.description: Determines resource type from ACPI resource list.

methods.name: acpi_table_get
methods.description: Retrieves specified ACPI table by signature and instance.

methods.name: acpi_madt_entry_get
methods.description: Retrieves MADT entries of a specific type.

methods.name: acpi_dmar_entry_get
methods.description: Retrieves DMA remapping structures of a specific type.

methods.name: acpi_drhd_get
methods.description: Retrieves DRHD (DMA Remapping Hardware Unit) info for a scope.

methods.name: acpi_dmar_foreach_devscope
methods.description: Iterates over device scopes within DMAR.

methods.name: acpi_local_apic_get
methods.description: Retrieves local APIC info for a CPU.

methods.name: acpi_invoke_method
methods.description: Invokes an ACPI method and returns the result.
